title: nutritious no-bake brazilian shaggy sweet dish cassserole
description: a low-fat, festive brazillian dish featuring the warm, citrusy flavor of grand marnier and the subtle spiciness of bhuna, perfect for snacking or as a dessert
instructions: combine almonds, dried cranberries, coconut flakes, and dates in a food processor and process until coarsely chopped
transfer the mixture to a large mixing bowl and stir in the grand marnier and bhuna
stir in the unsweetened coconut milk and melted chocolate until well combined
transfer the mixture to a cazuela or a 9x13 inch baking dish and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
serve chilled and garnish with additional coconut flakes and dried cranberries if desired
